notes.title: Limited Rescue is out !
notes.content:
The first version of Limited Rescue is now live on Steam !!
It is far from perfect and we're eager to hear your reviews and feedback to help us improve the game.

Please note that you can play with friend online through Steam "Remote Play" feature even if they do not own the game.

We highly recommend that you use a controller to get the best playing experience.

Let us know what you think, see you soon !
